name: Mantis Bug Tracker
description: Web-based bug and issue tracking system for software development teams.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DB_TYPE: mysqli
      DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-mariadb"
      DB_NAME: mantisbt
      DB_USER: mantisbt
      DB_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
      MANTIS_ADMIN_PASSWORD: {{env.MANTIS_ADMIN_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/config:/var/www/html/config
      - {{appDataPath}}/plugins:/var/www/html/plugins
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-mariadb
  {{serviceName}}-mariadb:
    image: mariadb:11
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mariadb
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: mantisbt
      MYSQL_USER: mantisbt
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/mariadb:/var/lib/mysql
